title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Four Million Pesos for the Purchase of a Parcel of Land Near the Capitol Site in Quezon City, to be Known as the “Congressional Employees Homesite”
title.vi: Khu Nhà ở Nhân viên Quốc hội
title.th: ที่ดินที่อยู่อาศัยของเจ้าหน้าที่รัฐสภา

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3091_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of four million pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase of a parcel of land near the Capitol site in Quezon City, to be known as the "Congressional Employees Homesite," to be subdivided into residential lots and sold at cost to officers and employees of the Congress of the Philippines who have rendered five or more years of continuous service: Provided , That the permanent employees shall have first priority.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961
